name: qr-code
title: QR Code
description: A QR code for a value, drawn as one crisp SVG path — dark modules on a light rounded tile in both themes, with the standard quiet zone — encoded on the server or the client by uqr.

meta.whenToUse: Handing a link to a phone: a scan-to-open code beside the link itself (record on your phone, open in the app, join a call).
meta.whenNotToUse: The only way to reach something — always show or copy the link too (CopyButton); a barcode or an image someone uploaded (Image).
